description: User profiles, follow/unfollow system, and search & explore. Depends on FEAT-001 (auth, DB) and FEAT-002 (posts). Independent of FEAT-004 (notifications UI, messages, settings).
steps: Create routes/users.js. Mount on /api/users. Endpoints: GET /suggestions — requireAuth, return up to 8 users not already followed by current user and not the current user, ordered by follower count DESC. GET /:username — optionalAuth, return user profile (all fields except password_hash), plus post_count, follower_count, following_count, is_following (bool, only if authenticated). GET /:username/posts — optionalAuth, return posts by that user, same enriched query as posts feed. GET /:username/followers — return list of followers with username/full_name/avatar/is_following. GET /:username/following — return list of following users. PUT /me — requireAuth, validate and update full_name, bio, location, website, and optionally upload avatar (avatarUpload middleware) or cover (coverUpload middleware). If new avatar/cover uploaded and user already has one, delete old file from uploads/.

Create routes/follows.js (not listed in spec but needed). Mount on /api/follows. POST /:userId — requireAuth, prevent self-follow (return 400), INSERT OR IGNORE into follows, create notification (type='follow'), return { following: true, follower_count }. DELETE /:userId — requireAuth, delete from follows, return { following: false, follower_count }.
Register routes in server.js: app.use('/api/users', usersRouter); app.use('/api/follows', followsRouter).

Create routes/search.js. Mount on /api/search. GET / — query param ?q=&type=all|users|posts. Users: SELECT from users WHERE username LIKE '%q%' OR full_name LIKE '%q%', return with is_following. Posts: SELECT from posts JOIN users WHERE posts.content LIKE '%q%', return enriched post objects. Limit both to 20 results. GET /trending — return 6 posts with most likes in last 7 days. Register as app.use('/api/search', searchRouter) in server.js.

Create public/profile.html. Three-column layout (same sidebars as index.html). Center column: cover image div, avatar positioned overlapping cover, user full_name, @username, bio, location, website link, join date, stats row (posts/followers/following counts as clickable buttons), tabs (Posts | Followers | Following), tab content div#profile-content. If viewing own profile: 'Edit Profile' button; otherwise 'Follow'/'Following' toggle button. Script tags: app.js then profile.js.

Create public/explore.html. Three-column layout. Center column: search bar div#explore-search (text input with search icon button), category filter pills row (All, Photography, Travel, Art, Technology, Food, Lifestyle — static labels that filter by appending label as search query), trending posts grid div#trending-grid (CSS grid 2-3 columns of post thumbnails), search results div#search-results (hidden by default). Script tags: app.js then explore.js.

Create public/js/profile.js. On DOMContentLoaded: read username from URL param ?user=username (or use current user if no param). Fetch GET /api/users/:username to populate profile header. Fetch GET /api/users/:username/posts to render posts in #profile-content. Wire follow/unfollow button: POST or DELETE /api/follows/:userId, update button state and counts. Wire tab switching (Posts | Followers | Following): on click Followers tab fetch GET /api/users/:username/followers, render user cards; on Following tab fetch following list. Edit profile button (own profile only): open a modal with form fields (full_name, bio, location, website, avatar file input, cover file input), on submit PUT /me with FormData (multipart for file uploads), on success refresh profile data, update localStorage currentUser.

Create public/js/explore.js. On DOMContentLoaded: fetch GET /api/search/trending, render into #trending-grid as image tiles (or text tiles if no image) with like count overlay. Wire #explore-search form submit: fetch GET /api/search?q=query&type=all, show #search-results section with user cards and post cards. Wire category pills: on click, fetch /api/search?q=categoryLabel&type=posts, render results. Wire click on user cards to navigate to /profile.html?user=username.
Commit: 'feat(FEAT-003): user profiles, follow system, search and explore'
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/users/:username returns profile data including counts
POST /api/follows/:userId creates a follow relationship; GET /api/users/:username shows is_following: true
DELETE /api/follows/:userId removes the follow; follower_count decrements
profile.html?user=testuser loads that user's profile and posts
Follow/unfollow button on profile.html toggles correctly and updates counts
Search for a username returns matching user(s) in results
Category filter pill click returns posts matching that category text
Edit profile modal on own profile saves changes (bio, avatar upload) and reflects them immediately
verification: Register two users. From user A: visit /profile.html?user=userB, click Follow — count increments
Visit /explore.html — trending grid renders, search for userB — user card appears in results
Edit profile as user A: upload avatar, change bio — changes persist after page refresh
No JS errors in browser devtools on any profile or explore page action
